name: Getac T800-Ex
statusNote: No longer in Getac's range; no end-of-sale notice.
summary: The Getac T800-Ex is the hazardous-area version of a Getac rugged 8.1-inch tablet, certified for Zone 2/22 under IECEx. It is an intrinsically safe (Ex ic) design; its operating system version isn't published. It has been discontinued.

iecex.marking: Ex ic op is IIC T4 Gc / Ex ic op is IIIB T130°C Dc

certification.protection: Intrinsic safety (Ex ic) with inherently safe optical radiation (op is)

safety.conditions: Use only in a controlled environment with reduced pollution; protect from UV light and mechanical impact (impact tested at reduced height); connection interfaces must never be used in hazardous areas; the battery must never be changed, charged or removed in hazardous areas; keep away from strong charge-generating processes; use only Getac battery packs BP2S2P2100S or BP4S1P2100S (IECEx EPS 16.0015X).
safety.peripherals: Connection interfaces must never be used in hazardous areas.
safety.certifiedAccessories: Tether; digitizer pen or stylus pen (named in the certificate).

unconfirmed.launchYear: Approximate: the maker doesn't publish a launch date. Based on the certificate date or the maker's announcement.

limitations: No longer in the maker's current range
Zone 2 only, so not for Zone 1 areas
T4 temperature class: fine for most gases, but not those that ignite below 135 °C
Dust group IIIB: combustible flyings and non-conductive dust only, not conductive dust
